description: Change dpkg package selection state via --get-selections and --set-selections.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: The selection state to set the package to. Choices: "install" "hold" "deinstall" "purge"

examples:
- name: Prevent python from being upgraded
  ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections:
    name: python
    selection: hold

- name: Allow python to be upgraded
  ansible.builtin.dpkg_selections:
    name: python
    selection: install
